cross_entry_follow_up.network: The fixture configuration keeps runtime.allow_network=false. Test-support clones it for the fixture Engine and opens its shared gate so explicit-source fixtures can run; the registry overrides PT/RainViewer with file-only adapters and SG with a logged empty-discovery stub. These adapters do not call HTTP/FTP transports. SG's auto+bilinear exclusion is asserted before discovery and fetch. No public upstream request was made.

cases.pt_raw: The receipt-bound PTST2 frame was selected by CLI, sync SDK, and async SDK at 1 km spacing. Frame logical ID, valid_time, receipt, processing record, and grid matched; RGBA SHA-256 matched across all three. Repeating with radius 2 km retained frame identity/receipt, changed processing ID, and caused one fixture fetch per entry.
cases.rainviewer_decoded: The fixed RainViewer tile frame produced matching source identity, receipts, processing record, and grid through all three entries; numeric values and quality SHA-256 matched exactly.
cases.rainviewer_dbz: The fixed RainViewer tile frame produced matching source identity, receipts, processing record, and grid through all three entries; dBZ values and quality SHA-256 matched exactly.
cases.auto_bilinear_exclusion: PT raw geometry was excluded by auto+bilinear in all three entries; each returned no_candidate, no raw data, and no fetch.
cases.categorical_bilinear_exclusion: SG categorical selector was excluded by auto+bilinear in all three entries with unsupported_mode_or_geometry; discovery and fetch logs remained empty.
cases.native_failure: An invalid RainViewer native fixture failed consistently in all three entries; no entry returned a raw fallback.

SC-001.evidence: Bare cat configured-center/no-candidate and legacy source/file routes pass. Fixed PT/RainViewer fixtures now replay selected frames through CLI, sync SDK, and async SDK with identical frame/grid/processing identity and exact raw RGBA or values/quality fingerprints. Automatic selection still has no source with verified default-use admission, so the no-source bare-cat success criterion remains open.

SC-005.evidence: The six listed selection/data scenarios preserve source, current-frame domain, missing quality, and low values in the controlled Engine tests; zero incorrect cross-source transitions or invented no-rain values were observed in this matrix.

SC-006.evidence: Legacy source/file routing and sync/async terminal-result parity pass. Fixed PT raw and RainViewer decoded/dbz fixture replays match frame/receipt/processing/grid identity and exact output fingerprints through CLI, sync SDK, and async SDK; PT raw and SG categorical auto+bilinear exclusions also match, with SG discovery/fetch logs empty. Controlled no-candidate and native-failure outcomes match without raw fallback. CLI array fingerprints exist only in the test-support build. This is limited to the exercised fixtures and does not imply every provider or platform has equivalent evidence.

SC-007.evidence: Preflight resource limits, shared candidate deadlines, cancellation, CPU-worker release, and no late publish pass in controlled tests; broader stress/platform coverage remains open.

SC-002.evidence: 59 independent projection controls passed for distance, direction, center, dateline, high latitude, and polar cases; maximum inverse error 0 m. Provider pixel-location uncertainty remains separately constrained by each geometry record.

SC-003.evidence: Catalog tests and audit records preserve 48 RDCAP station IDs, 47 SIDARMA historical coordinates, 10 selectors, 26 product relations, and 95 external candidates; conflicts/unknowns remain explicit, no range becomes coverage, and all expansion stays 74.

SC-004.evidence: T036 aggregate US2 acceptance passed with independent projection controls, non-square sampling/registration, Core raw/numeric mode and cache/view-identity cases, and the fixed-input three-entry replay. Nearest sampling preserves the center 20 dBZ value and quality flag 1 exactly under both axis directions; local-view dBZ bilinear matches the Z-domain reference within 1e-4 dBZ. PT source pixel-location uncertainty remains separate from projection accuracy and independent pixel tie points remain unavailable.
